watch.summary: The creator reacts with hilarity to viral CCTV footage of a humanoid robot doing Cristiano Ronaldo's famous 'Siu' celebration after scoring a goal.

beats.what: Creator introduces the video of a robot doing the Ronaldo Siu celebration.
Creator points out the robot scored a mediocre free kick before celebrating.
Footage shows the robot executing the full jump and turn 'Siu' pose.
Creator bursts into laughter at the absurd spectacle.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: And people say Ronaldo is not the GOAT!
watch.why: The visual absurdity of a robot performing a iconic human sports celebration creates an instant comedic contrast. The creator's infectious laughter and playful Ronaldo commentary help frame the ridiculousness.
